% ADDED figure (2026-11-02): the diagrams of one example box (C6a/C6b/§CA.7); generated by qft-C/tools/c6diag/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  \tikzset{fdaE/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.28 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}}}
  % arrows point from the phi^dagger end to the phi end: y -> vertex -> x
  % (0) order lambda^0, two pairings
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[fda] (0,0.5)--(1.8,0.5); \draw[fda] (0,-0.5)--(1.8,-0.5);
    \foreach \p in {(0,0.5),(0,-0.5),(1.8,0.5),(1.8,-0.5)} \node[fdx] at \p {};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0,0.5){$y_1$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (0,-0.5){$y_2$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.8,0.5){$x_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.8,-0.5){$x_2$};
  \end{scope}
  \node at (2.75,0) {$+$};
  \begin{scope}[xshift=3.7cm]
    \draw[fdaE] (0,0.5)--(1.8,-0.5); \draw[fdaE] (0,-0.5)--(1.8,0.5);
    \foreach \p in {(0,0.5),(0,-0.5),(1.8,0.5),(1.8,-0.5)} \node[fdx] at \p {};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0,0.5){$y_1$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (0,-0.5){$y_2$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.8,0.5){$x_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.8,-0.5){$x_2$};
  \end{scope}
  \node[fdS,align=center] at (2.75,-1.35) {(0) order $\lambda^0$: only $\hat\phi\hat\phi^\dagger$ pairs,\\[1pt] $2!=2$ pairings, $D_{x_1y_1}D_{x_2y_2}+D_{x_1y_2}D_{x_2y_1}$};
  % (a) the vertex
  \begin{scope}[xshift=8.6cm]
    \draw[fda] (0,0.6)--(0.8,0); \draw[fda] (0,-0.6)--(0.8,0);
    \draw[fda] (0.8,0)--(1.6,0.6); \draw[fda] (0.8,0)--(1.6,-0.6);
    \foreach \p in {(0,0.6),(0,-0.6),(1.6,0.6),(1.6,-0.6)} \node[fdx] at \p {};
    \node[fdv] at (0.8,0){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0,0.6){$y_1$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (0,-0.6){$y_2$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.6,0.6){$x_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.6,-0.6){$x_2$};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (0.8,-0.08){$z$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (0.8,-1.35) {(a) two arrows in, two out\\[1pt] $N_D=4$, $S=1$};
  \end{scope}
  % (b) line times oriented tadpole
  \begin{scope}[xshift=0.3cm, yshift=-3.6cm]
    \draw[fda] (0,0.7)--(2.4,0.7);
    \draw[fda] (0,-0.3)--(1.2,-0.3); \draw[fda] (1.2,-0.3)--(2.4,-0.3);
    \draw[fda] (1.2,-0.3) arc[start angle=-90, end angle=270, radius=0.33];
    \foreach \p in {(0,0.7),(2.4,0.7),(0,-0.3),(2.4,-0.3)} \node[fdx] at \p {};
    \node[fdv] at (1.2,-0.3){};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0,0.7){$y_j$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (2.4,0.7){$x_i$};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0,-0.3){$y_{j'}$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (2.4,-0.3){$x_{i'}$};
    \node[fdlab,below] at (1.2,-0.36){$z$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (1.2,-1.4) {(b) line $\times$ oriented tadpole\\[1pt] $4$ diagrams $(i,j)$, $N_D=4$ each, $S=1$};
  \end{scope}
  % (c) two lines times oriented figure-eight
  \begin{scope}[xshift=7.6cm, yshift=-3.6cm]
    \draw[fda] (0,0.5)--(1.8,0.5); \draw[fda] (0,-0.5)--(1.8,-0.5);
    \foreach \p in {(0,0.5),(0,-0.5),(1.8,0.5),(1.8,-0.5)} \node[fdx] at \p {};
    \node[fdlab,left] at (0,0.5){$y_1$}; \node[fdlab,left] at (0,-0.5){$y_2$};
    \node[fdlab,right] at (1.8,0.5){$x_1$}; \node[fdlab,right] at (1.8,-0.5){$x_2$};
    \draw[fda] (3.2,0) arc[start angle=-90, end angle=270, radius=0.3];
    \draw[fda] (3.2,0) arc[start angle=90, end angle=-270, radius=0.3];
    \node[fdv] at (3.2,0){}; \node[fdlab,right] at (3.5,0){$z$};
    \node[fdS,align=center] at (1.9,-1.4) {(c) two lines $\times$ oriented figure-eight\\[1pt] $+\,(y_1\leftrightarrow y_2)$, $N_D=2$ each, $S=2$};
  \end{scope}
  \node[fdS] at (5.6,-6.0) {order $\lambda$: $4+16+4=24=4!$ pairings; coefficient $N_D/|G_1|$, $|G_1|=2!\,2!=4$; vertex $-i\frac{\lambda}{4}\cdot2!\,2!=-i\lambda$};
\end{tikzpicture}
